It's interesting, although (as I found out with mine) Ambrose really needs to be something special to stand out and I am not sure this is it.

Furthermore mentioning COVID-19 isn't going to help you here. Perhaps change that and try to steer clear of topics such this.

I am sitting at a No vote at the moment because I did enjoy some of the descriptions of the meals.

item.title: Jamcon Round 2!
item.content:encoded:
Here we go again.

stormbreath would like people to stop using this CSS, so if you're about to steal it from me, do so at your own peril. (Thanks to stormbreath for the original css which I swear I stole before he asked us to stop using it.)

I tried to loop in as much local lore/culinary tradition as I could without it being too homerish. But this is definitely an ode to my beloved city, in all of our weird glory.
